newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TNT sells majority Brazil interest.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TNT sells majority Brazil interest.

text.p: Transport and logistics group TNT ltd said on Monday it had sold a majority interest in its Brazilian road transport opreations.

Saying the Brazilian disposal continued the group's rationalisation of underperforming operations, TNT said it would retain a 20 percent interest and that the financial details of the transaction were not material.

The company said it would maintain full ownership of its Brazilian logistics operations while its associate GD Express Worlwide would maintian its Brazilian international time sensitive freight services.
